name: Probably Sudoku
subtitle: Roguelike Logic & Combos
promotionalText: Sudoku rules, roguelike twists. Build powerful combos with Bookmarks and Markers, beat Boss puzzles, and learn the essentials in hands-on practice.
whatsNew: Fixed an issue that could interrupt ad loading when returning to the rescue offer. Clearer messages now explain when a video cannot load. You remain in control: retry manually or end the Book.
description:
Probably Sudoku is a roguelike number puzzle built around Sudoku rules, powerful combos and Books with personality.

Choose from 12 Books, each with its own ability and questionable encouragement. Place numbers using Sudoku rules, build scoring combinations, and reach each puzzle's target before your turns run out. You don't have to fill every square to win.

A BOOK WORTH FINISHING
Each run spans nine levels and 27 puzzles. Plan around clearly announced Boss powers, then face one of five major final Bosses on the last page. Finish a Book to unlock its next Obstacle difficulty. Every Book keeps its own progress.

MAKE THE NUMBERS WORK FOR YOU
Spend earned coins on Bookmarks that strengthen your build, Markers that reward selected squares, and one-use Buffs for a timely advantage. Make the most of the numbers in your hand, decide when to toss them, and discover combinations that turn a modest move into a much bigger score.

PAPER, PERSONALITY AND ONE MORE TRY
Browse a rotating book rack, turn flexible paper pages, and enjoy gentle music, sound effects and tactile feedback. Adjust the audio to suit you. Interactive practice teaches placement, multipliers, buying and selling, Markers and Buffs. Replay it from Settings, and return to your saved Book whenever you're ready.

Play without a required login. Optional rewarded videos can grant three extra turns, once per puzzle, when an ad is available.

Your next good idea is probably one number away.
reviewNotes:
Version 1.0.2 (build 14) improves optional rewarded-ad loading cancellation and error messages. Retrying remains manual; there is no automatic retry or automatic ad presentation. Gameplay, saved-game format, consent behavior and ad identifiers are unchanged from build 13.

Probably Sudoku is a free, single-player Sudoku strategy game by DlA. No app account, subscription or purchase is required. Game Center sign-in is optional; dismissing it does not prevent play.

To play: complete or skip the first-time tutorial, choose New Book, tap a book cover on the rack, select an available Obstacle tab, then Open the Book. Place numbers from your hand in valid Sudoku cells and tap End Turn to bank points. Reach the score target within the turn limit; filling the entire grid is not required. After reaching the target, the player may continue filling while empty cells and turns remain.

Bookmarks, Markers, Buffs and all shop purchases use coins earned only through gameplay. A run has 27 puzzles across nine levels. Completing the final Boss leads to Book Complete and unlocks the next Obstacle only for that Book.

The optional Watch ad offer appears after running out of turns below the score target. Completing a Google AdMob rewarded ad grants exactly three additional turns, once per puzzle, preserving the board, score and hand. Dismissing an ad without earning the reward grants no turns. The player can always choose End Book without watching. Ad availability depends on connectivity, consent and available inventory. No ad being available does not prevent normal play. There are no in-app purchases or paid currency.

Settings is available from the menu and in-game gear buttons. It includes Replay tutorial, audio controls, Privacy policy and Support links, and applicable ad privacy choices. Tutorial practice is separate from saved games and makes no ad requests. There is no required reviewer login.
